title: Block Strategy
description:
JOIN THE COMMUNITY

Об игреBlock Strategy is an RTS Base Defence roguelite with a fully destructible world. 

While trying to escape an overwhelming enemy force you warp through space to safety and must rebuild your base. Defeat enemies to receive a choice of upgrades and resources to allow you to specialise your units and base in different ways and defend from waves of enemies.

Gather enough strength (and fuel for your reactor) to travel to the enemy base and defeat them for good.

Place buildings to provide extra units, generate additional resources over time, power your base, or defend against waves of enemies. Enemies attack at specified intervals, giving you time to explore and gather resources before hunkering down to defend.

Create up to 6 hero units which can level-up and be augmented with different weapons and abilities. These allow units to specialise, becoming more of a damage dealer, healer, tank and more.

Explore the world , fight bosses and complete events to be rewarded with resources, buildings and upgrades.

Place blocks to block enemy paths, forcing them to attack where you're strongest, and allowing your units to reach new areas.

Destroy or mine blocks to gather resources and dig into caves

Enter caves, fading out the blocks above and providing an extra level of verticality to the world.
description_short: Block Strategy is an RTS Base Defence roguelite with a fully destructible world. Build your base and find fuel to power your reactor before you're overrun by an onslaught of enemy robots.
